key: AMARIA: Oh... You were \PN, right?
en: AMARIA: Oh... You were \PN, right?
ja: アマリア: あら……\PNだったよね?

key: Julia told me a little bit about you.
en: Julia told me a little bit about you.
ja: ジュリアから　少し　聞いてる。

key: If you're here for a Gym Battle, I'm sorry--
en: If you're here for a Gym Battle, I'm sorry--
ja: ジムバトルに　来たなら　ごめん――

key: But can it wait until another time?
en: But can it wait until another time?
ja: また　今度に　してもらえる?

key: I'm just...
en: I'm just...
ja: あたし　ただ……

key: Do you ever think about how fragile we are as people?
en: Do you ever think about how fragile we are as people?
ja: 人間って　どれだけ　もろいものか　考えたこと　ある?

key: It's so peaceful down here.
en: It's so peaceful down here.
ja: ここは　とても　穏やかなの。

key: But one mistake could fill our lungs with water and make us rot from the inside out.
en: But one mistake could fill our lungs with water and make us rot from the inside out.
ja: でも　一つの間違いで　肺は　水で　満たされて　内側から　腐っていく。

key: Maybe someday I'll have a lucky mistake.
en: Maybe someday I'll have a lucky mistake.
ja: いつか　ラッキーな間違いが　起きるかもね。

key: So there's really no point in us battling.
en: So there's really no point in us battling.
ja: だから　今　あたしたちが　バトルする意味　本当に　ないの。

key: I hope you understand.
en: I hope you understand.
ja: わかって　もらえるといいけど。

key: Bye!
en: Bye!
ja: テンシ: バイバイ!

key: AMARIA: Oh, you're still here?
en: AMARIA: Oh, you're still here?
ja: アマリア: あら　まだ　いたの?

key: I should apologize for what I said before;
en: I should apologize for what I said before;
ja: さっきの言葉　謝るべきよね。

key: That was completely inappropriate of me to say to a challenger.
en: That was completely inappropriate of me to say to a challenger.
ja: 挑戦者に　言うことじゃ　全然　なかった。

key: It's just how I get caught up in thinking sometimes.
en: It's just how I get caught up in thinking sometimes.
ja: 時々　考えに　のみこまれちゃう　だけなの。

key: I'm not saying that I want to die or anything--
en: I'm not saying that I want to die or anything--
ja: 死にたいって　言ってるわけじゃ　ないけど――

key: But if it happened...
en: But if it happened...
ja: もし　そうなったら……

key: I wouldn't mind.
en: I wouldn't mind.
ja: かまわないかな。

key: In fact, Tania would probably be better off that way--
en: In fact, Tania would probably be better off that way--
ja: っていうか　ターニャも　そのほうが　きっと　いいだろうし――

key: And you wouldn't have to waste time with me either.
en: And you wouldn't have to waste time with me either.
ja: あんたも　あたしに　時間を　むだにしなくて済むし。

key: Ahaha, what kind of Gym Leader talks like this?
en: Ahaha, what kind of Gym Leader talks like this?
ja: あはは　こんな話し方する　ジムリーダーって　いる?

key: That's why I'm just not suited to it at all.
en: That's why I'm just not suited to it at all.
ja: だから　あたしは　まったく　向いてないの。

key: So... don't bother with me, okay?
en: So... don't bother with me, okay?
ja: だから……　あたしに　構わないでね?

key: AMARIA: You followed me down here?
en: AMARIA: You followed me down here?
ja: アマリア: こんなとこまで　ついてきたの?

key: I was really hoping you wouldn't...
en: I was really hoping you wouldn't...
ja: 本当に　来ないでほしかったのに……

key: I didn't want to say anything undue, but...
en: I didn't want to say anything undue, but...
ja: 余計なこと　言いたくないんだけど……

key: Why do you have those Bracelets?
en: Why do you have those Bracelets?
ja: なんで　そのブレスレット　持ってるの?

key: Those are the Bracelets Titania gave me.
en: Those are the Bracelets Titania gave me.
ja: それ　ティタニアが　あたしに　くれた　ブレスレットよ。

key: They belong to me.
en: They belong to me.
ja: あたしのものなの。

key: I thought I lost them, but then here you are...
en: I thought I lost them, but then here you are...
ja: なくしたと思ってたけど　あんたが　持ってるなんて……

key: Won't you give them back?
en: Won't you give them back?
ja: 返してくれない?

key: Hey, do you ever think about how fragile we are as people?
en: Hey, do you ever think about how fragile we are as people?
ja: ねえ　人間って　どれだけ　もろいものか　考えたこと　ある?

key: When we're down here, just one mistake could fill our lungs with water and make us rot from the inside out.
en: When we're down here, just one mistake could fill our lungs with water and make us rot from the inside out.
ja: ここに　いるときは　一つの間違いで　肺は　水で　満たされて　内側から　腐っていく。

key: So, where is Tania anyway?
en: So, where is Tania anyway?
ja: それで　ターニャは　どこに　いるの?

key: Why are you here and she's not?
en: Why are you here and she's not?
ja: なんで　あんたが　いて　彼女が　いないの?

key: Did you do something?
en: Did you do something?
ja: 何か　したの?

key: I'm-- sorry...
en: I'm-- sorry...
ja: ご……　ごめん……

key: That was very rude of me...
en: That was very rude of me...
ja: すごく　失礼だった……

key: I should go.
en: I should go.
ja: もう　行かなきゃ。

key: AMARIA: You don't know when to stop.
en: AMARIA: You don't know when to stop.
ja: アマリア: あんたって　やめどきが　わからない子ね。

key: You're like me that way, aren't you?
en: You're like me that way, aren't you?
ja: あたしと　似てるかも。

key: AMARIA: She's going to leave me, isn't she?
en: AMARIA: She's going to leave me, isn't she?
ja: アマリア: 彼女　あたしから　離れていくんでしょ?

key: That's what she came to warn me about.
en: That's what she came to warn me about.
ja: それを　警告しに　来たんでしょ。

key: It's your fault, isn't it?
en: It's your fault, isn't it?
ja: あんたの　せいなんでしょ?

key: Hey, \PN, do you want to know a secret?
en: Hey, \PN, do you want to know a secret?
ja: ねえ\PN　秘密　知りたい?

key: AMARIA: But I won't tell you.
en: AMARIA: But I won't tell you.
ja: アマリア: でも　教えない。

key: AMARIA: I don't need to tell you.
en: AMARIA: I don't need to tell you.
ja: アマリア: 教える必要　ないもの。

key: Secrets are only as good as the whispers that betray them.
en: Secrets are only as good as the whispers that betray them.
ja: 秘密なんて　裏切るささやき次第の　もの。

key: And dead men can tell no tales.
en: And dead men can tell no tales.
ja: それに　死人に　口なし。

key: AMARIA: Too bad.
en: AMARIA: Too bad.
ja: アマリア: 残念だったね。

key: AMARIA: Not that it would have mattered anyway...
en: AMARIA: Not that it would have mattered anyway...
ja: アマリア: どのみち　どうでも　よかったんだけど……

key: After all... dead men can tell no tales.
en: After all... dead men can tell no tales.
ja: だって……　死人に　口なしだもの。

key: AMARIA: Don't you get it?
en: AMARIA: Don't you get it?
ja: アマリア: わかんないの?

key: This is a matter of life and death for both of us.
en: This is a matter of life and death for both of us.
ja: これは　あたしたち二人にとって　生きるか死ぬかの問題　なんだよ。

key: Titania is my air.
en: Titania is my air.
ja: ティタニアは　あたしの　空気。

key: And since you've come, I've suffocated.
en: And since you've come, I've suffocated.
ja: あんたが　来てから　あたしは　息が　できてない。

key: AMARIA: "Huh?
en: AMARIA: "Huh?
ja: アマリア: 「え?

key: \PN was here? I don't remember seeing anyone..."
en: \PN was here? I don't remember seeing anyone..."
ja: \PNが　いたって? 誰かを　見た覚えなんて　ないけど……」

key: You can drown.
en: You can drown.
ja: あんたは　溺れればいい。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
